item.title: Local businessman buys former Monaghan Town Co-Op
item.description: A Co Monaghan businessman has confirmed that he has purchased the former Co-Op site in Monaghan Town. Michael Treanor of Monaghan Electrical Wholesaler Limited told this morning's Joe Finnegan Show that he purchased the iconic premises over the last month. Monaghan Town Co-Op closed its doors one last time in 2025, after 124 years in operation. Advertisement The local business had employed generations of local people over its 100 years in existence. item.title: Monaghan man jailed for 2 years over serious assault of ex-partner
item.description: A Co Monaghan man who subjected his ex partner to a brutal attack in which he punched her several times in the head in front of their crying child has been jailed for two years. Patrick Sherry (34), with an address at Castle Hill Park, Ballygawley, Co Tyrone, pleaded guilty to two counts of assault causing harm to Maryann McQuillan at her home in Monaghan over a period of days at Christmas in 2020. item.title: Tracker Mortgage scandal raised by Cavan Councillor
item.description: A Co Cavan Councillor has brought a motion to Cavan County Council in relation to the Tracker Mortgage scandal. Cllr Shane P O’Reilly called on the Central Bank to give concrete confirmation of the fail safe measures and procedures that they have in place that no such scandal could ever happen again. item.title: Monaghan farmers attend Bord Bia protest
item.description: Farmers from across the Northern Sound region attended a protest outside Bord Bia today. The IFA is protesting against Bord Bia chairperson Larry Murrin, after it emerged that his company, Dawn Farms' imported Brazilian beef. Newbliss farmer David Hall the IFA's Animal Health Chair, attended the protest in Dublin this morning. item.title: Exhibition on role of Protestant associations on border
item.description: An exhibition about the Protestant associations of Cavan, Donegal, and Monaghan will take place next weekend. These were the former unionist associations that changed after partition, to focus on Protestant interests. Dr. Samuel Beckon is the stakeholder manager for a cross-border and cross-community peace initiative. item.description: A Cavan County Councillor has voiced his concerns about safety measures on a local junction. The area of concern is the Laragh House junction at the R165 Stradone to Cootehill road. Val Smith, Cathaoirleach of Bailieborough-Cootehill Municipal Disrict has described the junction as very dangerous. item.title: Monaghan to Roslea road reopens following crash
item.description: The R187 between Monaghan and Roslea has reopened following a fatal road traffic collision. Gardaí and emergency services attended the single-vehicle road crash at Inishammon, Smithboro at around 7:30pm last night. Smithboro man Adrian Keenan who is aged in his 30s died at the scene.
